status: prepared; candidate not selected; final seeds unused
scope: Germany, three players, automatic setup, original/Recharged, open/sealed
pairing: Each independent deal is repeated across all three candidate seats and all four rule combinations.
intervals: 95% bootstrap intervals resample independent deals, retaining correlated seat and rule repeats. Intervals are per comparison, not a simultaneous family-wide confidence claim.

requirements.export_action_parity: All 427 fixture positions must agree with the training checkpoint.
requirements.cpu_serving: All 427 fixtures must return legal moves on the AMD 8840U; report cold, warm, search-only and phase-specific latency.
requirements.package: Verify file hashes and legal responses from the extracted standalone archive.

failure_policy: A failed gate is reported as a failure; do not weaken thresholds after seeing final results. Any subsequent model selection uses new development evidence and a new final seed prefix.
claim_limits: These gates establish strength against the measured opponent suite, not expert-human strength, other maps/player counts, or calibrated analysis values.
